name: com.studiogaku.gameplay-rules
description: Bundles the deterministic, engine-independent gameplay calculations for resources and costs, stat modifiers, weighted selection and integer allocation, piecewise curves and threshold tiers, rolling sampling statistics and linear trends, timed stacks, stack transfers and periodic ticks, and numeric requirement, utility score, threat score, and damage mitigation evaluation into one package.

samples.description: Compares restore, partial spend, full-required spend, exact depletion, invalid input rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares payable, shortage, missing-balance, zero-cost, and invalid-input plans with responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares flat, additive-percent, multiplicative-factor, update, duplicate rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry scenarios.
Adds three weighted entries, selects two explicit samples, and verifies responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Demonstrates equal, exact weighted, largest-remainder, zero-weight, and zero-total allocations with responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Adds three points, evaluates two queries, and verifies responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Adds four samples to a capacity-three FIFO window, verifies eviction and clear, and checks responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares balanced, constant, spread, subrange, and out-of-range samples and checks responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares rising, flat, falling, noisy, and out-of-range samples and checks responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Evaluates five values against Bronze, Silver, and Gold thresholds and checks responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Spends three charges and verifies boundary recharge, tick-jump catch-up, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Demonstrates future, exact, catch-up, limited, and completed periodic tick plans with responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Demonstrates add, replace, maximum, refresh, extend, clamp, and inactive-to-active timed-stack policies with responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Demonstrates full, partial, source-limited, destination-limited, and zero-unit transfer plans with responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares all-pass, mixed, tolerance, strict, and invalid requirement sets with responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares highest, weighted, tied, fully explained, and invalid candidate sets with responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Demonstrates initial selection, current retention, threshold switching, tie retention, and missing-current recovery with responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares flat, ratio, ordered, clamped, and invalid mitigation plans with responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares add, reduce, ordered, clamped, and invalid threat adjustments with responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
